name: Amoeba
author: Abstract Games factory (game by Masahiro Nakajima, 2010)
description: Amoeba (Masahiro Nakajima, 2010; nestorgames): ten discs and a 'kernel' each on a 37-point hex board. A stack is controlled by whoever owns its top piece, so stacks change hands. Each turn either MOVE a stack you control in a straight line exactly as many points as it is high (nothing blocks it), or SOW it along that line -- bottom piece on the first point, next one up on the second, one per point -- which hands any enemy piece you were carrying straight back to its owner. Win by controlling a stack that contains the enemy kernel, or by leaving your opponent no legal move.
